sat_and_act_policies.clarification_for_test_policy: University of California, Los Angeles is test-blind for admission purposes.

data.additional_transfer_admission_requiremen: Transfer minimum college GPA is 2.4 for CA residents, 2.8 for nonresidents. 60 transferable semester units. 2 English composition courses, 1 Math, and 4 courses chosen from two of the following areas: arts & humanities
data.other_transfer_credit_policies: Requirements vary by program. Progress toward completion of major requirements and completion of UCLA general education requirements considered
data.other_military_veteran_transfer_policies: UCLA may award credit for military training but it does not adhere to the recommendations from ACE.
